title: Harden CI per DEC-240: no lifecycle scripts, no persisted credentials, exact Quest version, env-passed outputs
description: DEC-240 (opum-doc, 2026-10-25T14:10Z; plan item 13, dec-00icl6f = A) hardens CI in every repository. (1) Install lore and quest in CI with npm install -g --ignore-scripts <pkg>@<exact>. (2) Every actions/checkout step sets persist-credentials: false unless that job pushes with the token; a job that pushes keeps it and says why in a comment. (3) The Quest version is read only from inside the managed Quest block markers and must match ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ exactly; anything else fails the job by name and never reaches npm as a range. (4) A step output used in a shell step reaches it through env:, never interpolated as ${{ }} inside run:. Items 1 and 3 apply only where this repo CI installs lore or quest; items 2 and 4 apply to every workflow. Out of scope: pinning third-party actions by SHA (Wednesday grooming). DEC-182 (1) floor work: Sonnet or above authors, Opus reviews before landing. The author does not land it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every workflow in .github/workflows that installs lore or quest from npm passes --ignore-scripts and an exact version; proved by an install with a dependency carrying a deliberately failing postinstall that still succeeds
Every actions/checkout step sets persist-credentials: false, except a job that pushes with the token, which keeps it and says why in a comment

Wherever a workflow reads the Quest version from CLAUDE.md it reads only inside the managed block markers and requires ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$; proved by a CLAUDE.md with a partial version failing the read by name
No step output is interpolated as ${{ }} inside a run: block; each reaches the shell through env:
Items that do not apply are recorded on this task with what was measured, and no third-party action is re-pinned by SHA

implementationNotes: MEASURED, per item (workflows read at origin/dev 8a3407d3). (1) npm installs of lore/quest: lore-check.yml pinned lore install (now --ignore-scripts) and scripts/qualification/prepublish.mjs lore install (now --ignore-scripts, runs in prepublication-qualification.yml). release.yml installs only npm@^11 and prepublication installs @salient-ai/jira-cli and @anthropic-ai/claude-code: neither is lore or quest, so DEC-240 (1) does not reach them; left as is, not measured for postinstall need. scripts/lore-pin-staleness.mjs readPin regex widened to accept the new install line (qcli358 stays green). Quest itself is not installed from npm in CI: it is built from the checkout. (2) 9 checkout steps across 7 workflows, all now persist-credentials: false. No job pushes with the token (grep for git push/tag/gh release in workflows: none; permissions are contents: read throughout), so no job keeps the credential. (3) The only CLAUDE.md version read is tracker-integrity.yml, which used a loose regex Quest CLI \([0-9][0-9.]*\) accepting a prefix of a partial version; it now calls scripts/read-declared-quest-version.mjs (inside markers only, ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$, fails by name). No CI step passes a Quest version to npm; the rule is enforced anyway. (4) Step outputs interpolated in run: bodies: lore-check.yml steps.lore.outputs.method and release.yml steps.qualification.outputs.run_id, both moved to env:. Other ${{ }} in run: bodies are matrix.target at prepublication-qualification.yml (a literal matrix value, not a step output) left unchanged. PROOF, both ways, test/qcli535-dec240-ci-hardening.test.ts (7 tests): packed dependency with postinstall `exit 1`, npm install --ignore-scripts exits 0 and the control with --dangerously-allow-all-scripts exits nonzero (npm 12.2.0 here blocks scripts by default, npm 11 on runners runs them, so the control forces them on); read-declared-quest-version.mjs given 0.14 / 0 / ^0.14.1 / ~0.14.1 / 0.14.x / 0.14.1-rc.1 / v0.14.1 / 0.14.1.2 exits 1 naming the value on stderr with empty stdout, a good block prints 0.14.1, a version only outside markers is refused. MUTATION: removing one persist-credentials line, re-inlining the run_id expression, and dropping --ignore-scripts from the lore install turned exactly those three scan tests red (4 pass, 3 fail); restored 7/7. Local: typecheck, format, layer, lockfile pins pass; lint has the same 8 pre-existing warnings; the only failing test in the touched set is the known QCLI-411 bun 1.3.14 pin check.
